CodeLima 0.3.3 keeps terminal tab names and status current while you work in
another tab, and clears bell indicators when you visit their tab.

- Tabs use the running program's reported title without an added node name or
  positional number. Untitled tabs retain the fallback; host tabs retain `host:`.
- Titles, application-provided working spinners, progress and bell alerts
  continue updating in background tabs and unfocused windows.
- Background bells appear as `Title 🔔`, with no dot separator. Visiting the tab
  clears the indicator; a new background bell can show it again. Each TUI window
  acknowledges its own visits.
- Delayed terminal snapshots cannot overwrite newer tab metadata or undo an
  authoritative reconnect.

Upgrade an existing Homebrew installation:

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade codelima
codelima daemon update
codelima --version
```

Reopen attached TUIs after updating the daemon. This release uses daemon
protocol 7, so the daemon and frontend must both be updated. The update command
supports the previous daemon's compatibility handshake and preserves live
terminal sessions when handoff succeeds.

**Qualification status:** local Linux arm64 automated and live host-TUI checks
pass; publication requires verification, race, integration and package checks
on macOS arm64 and Linux amd64/arm64. Native physical-terminal, real Lima
VM/forwarding, actual Homebrew upgrade and the full interactive QA matrix
remain incomplete, along with the deferred full upstream Ghostty Debug suite.
These limits remain tracked in TODO #41/#44/#50; publication does not mark them
complete. See the
[qualification report](https://github.com/brianrackle/codelima/blob/main/plans/tab_status_release_qa.md).

Archives contain both `codelima` and `codelima-renderer-worker`; keep them
together for manual installations. Supported targets are macOS arm64,
Linux amd64, and Linux arm64.
